MATTHEW WAYNE LACKO December 29, 1989 - March 11, 2017 It is with broken hearts we announce the sudden passing of our beloved son and brother, Matthew Wayne Lacko on Saturday March 11, 2017 at the age of 27 years. He will be sadly missed by his mother and father Ramona and Wayne Lacko, brothers Nicholas (Ainsley) and Christian (Nicole), grandmothers Lorraine Roth and Pearl Lacko, and a host of many aunts, uncles, and cousins. Matthew grew up in Winnipeg in a loving family with many friends. From an early age, making connections and bonding with people came easy to Matt. His sense of humour was legendary. He genuinely had a natural ability and desire for making any excuse to cause people to laugh. He enjoyed being the centre of attention but was sensitive to those who were shy or seen as outcasts. Matthew spent the last few years living in Edmonton, AB. He was working as an electrician apprentice at Kel's Electrical. He was hardworking, well liked, and took pride in his work. Matt was a naturally gifted athlete who excelled in all sports. He enjoyed his hockey and currently played for two teams. He will be greatly missed by his Snake Arm teammates. Matthew was always up for an adventure. Among them: skydiving, long boarding, fishing, golfing, and snowboarding. Family gatherings spent at Crow Lake will be fondly remembered. Since his late teens, Matthew struggled with mental illness, but through it all and till the end, Matthew knew he was loved and we knew he loved us. He had an open mind, a giving heart and a consideration for others. Wayne and Ramona, Nicholas and Christian express their heartfelt gratitude to the many that reached out to support Matthew over the years, both here in Winnipeg and especially the family in Edmonton. There will be a Mass of Christian Burial on Tuesday, March 21, 2017 at 10:00 a.m. at St. Gianna Beretta Molla Roman Catholic Church, 15 Columbia Drive, Winnipeg, MB. As an expression of sympathy, memorial contributions may be made in Matthew's name to Manitoba Schizophrenia Society. Matthew, may you now find true peace and that it will set you free.
Publish Date: Mar 18, 2017
